specific_flows.donation_split: Use Shadcn Slider, styled with #7C191E track and #D4AF37 thumb. Show dynamic percentages that adjust other sliders when one moves to ensure total is 100%.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond and Manrope.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn card component for marketing pages. Build custom HTML bento grids with overlapping divs, using the Tetris Mode strategy.
For the donation split sliders, build a custom interactive component that links values so they never exceed 100%.
Dashboards should use 'Control Room' tight grid layout (gap-6) with 1px border. No heavy box-shadows. Use a warm off-white background (#F9F6F0) and pure white (#FFFFFF) for the cards.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are attached to all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and forms using kebab-case.
Do not use emojis anywhere in the UI. Use SVG patterns or the provided image URLs.
